blocks.text: Chlorine doosre anasir se chlorides banati hai, aur yeh pani mein khaas rawaiya dikhate hain, aise mahlool dete hue jo acidic ya neutral hote hain.

items: Neutral chlorides: woh namak jo pani mein hal ho kar 7 ke qareeb pH wala neutral mahlool dete hain. Period 3 ke shuru mein sodium aur magnesium ke chlorides pani se react nahin karte; un ke mahlool mein pani ke molecules se ghire musbat dhaati ions aur manfi chloride ions hain, jo ab hydrated ions kehlate hain, aur yeh amal hydration hai. NaCl(s) se Na+(aq) + Cl-(aq), pH 7; MgCl2(s) se Mg2+(aq) + 2Cl-(aq), pH 6.5. Group 1 aur group 2 ke chlorides chand istisnaon ke saath neutral hain.

Acidic chlorides: period 3 mein aluminium se sulfur tak tamam chlorides pani se react kar ke 7 se kam pH wale acidic mahlool banate hain, yeh amal hydrolysis kehlata hai. Jab AlCl3 pani mein dala jaye to hydrated Al3+ ion pani ke molecule se ek H+ ion khilwata hai, jo mahlool ko acidic banata hai: AlCl3(s) + 3H2O(l) se Al(OH)3(s) + 3HCl(aq). Doosri misalein: SiCl4(l) + 2H2O(l) se SiO2(s) + 4HCl(aq); PCl3(l) + 3H2O(l) se H3PO3(s) + 3HCl(aq).

blocks.prompt: AlCl3 acidic chloride kyun hai jab ke NaCl nahin, aur PCl5 aur NCl3 acidic honge ya basic?
blocks.explanation: Sodium chloride sirf hal hota hai: us ke ions hydrated hote hain aur mahlool neutral rehta hai. Chhota, zyada charge wala Al3+ ion pani ke molecule se H+ kheench leta hai, hydrolysis, HCl chhorta aur mahlool ko acidic banata hai. PCl5 aur NCl3 covalent non-metal chlorides hain, to yeh bhi pani mein hydrolyse ho kar acidic mahlool dete hain; koi basic nahin.

items: Neutral chlorides (NaCl pH 7, MgCl2 pH 6.5) sirf hydrate hote hain. Al se S tak acidic chlorides hydrolyse ho kar HCl chhorte hain: AlCl3 se Al(OH)3, SiCl4 se SiO2, PCl3 se H3PO3, har ek HCl ke saath.
